newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ says Mar qtr underlying inflation 0.22 pct.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ says Mar qtr underlying inflation 0.22 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Tuesday underlying inflation for the March 1997 quarter was 0.22 percent, making 1.97 percent for the year.

The central bank, which is mandated to aim for underlying inflation between 0-3 percent, had forecast a quarterly rate of 0.5 percent, for an annual rate of 2.2 percent. Economists' consensus forecast was for 0.41 percent quarterly and 2.16 percent annually.
